peoples_entry.name: Dasri
peoples_entry.note: The Dasri of the Jabal Shiekdom, sunken red-rock Shade, Mantis, and the Free Confederacy (LORE.md §6.8, PROPOSAL-JABAL-EAST-NOMADS.md, settlements/shade): Bedouin and Chiricahua/Mescalero Apache syncretism under the Sign of the Horns — flowing bisht/aba coats, keffiyeh/litham wraps bound with double black goat-hair 'iqal coils, Sana'a/Jabal juss chevron & qamariya brocades, silver hirz talisman cases, and curved jambiya daggers fused with smoke-ochre buckskin fringed war-shirts, crimson concho war-headbands, knee-high folded-top upturned-toe Apache ndee cactus-boots, copper mezcal alembic packs, and horned Gaan spirit-crowns (tools/garments/cultures/dasri.py).
